test(bench): preserve term identity in UPDATE differential coverage (#6482)

* test(bench): bound UPDATE lexical adjudication to injective terms

Narrow generated integer values to disjoint lexical pools, including LOAD, while preserving draw counts and operation probabilities. Refuse lossy term/row/blank-node adjudication and retain the exact historical Sparq-only sequence.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>

* test(bench): validate lexical adjudication under workspace edition

Preserve original dataset details on lexical adjudication failures, pin integer spelling pools independently, and make the marker test allowlist explicit. Replace Rust 2024 let chains with equivalent Rust 2021 syntax to match sparq-bench.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>
